notes.title: IxSHE TELL RELEASE DATE AND STEAM STORE PAGE
notes.content:
[b]Hey everyone![/b]

[h1][b]We are really excited to announce that the Steam page for our next game IxSHE Tell is now live![/b][/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1340120/IxSHE_Tell/

[h1][b]The game will be released on Friday, August 28th, 2020 at 10 AM PDT / 1 PM EDT / 7 PM CEST![/b][/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33069582/916ebbdf685ef7eef2db68a30d907386edf9023c.jpg[/img]

[b]If you want to know more about the game visit our product page: http://ixshe.nekonyansoft.com/

Follow us on our social media to get faster information on our next upcoming games!

TWITTER: https://twitter.com/NekoNyanSoft
FACEBOOK: https://www.facebook.com/NekoNyanSoft/
WEBSITE: https://nekonyansoft.com/[/b]

notes.title: PATCHNOTES 1.23
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Today we have another small patch for you that fixes some minor issues.
We hope you're still having fun with the game!
The Steam page for our next upcoming game "Hello, good-bye" will be also up later this week, so stay tuned for that!

To download the patch immediately just restart your Steam client.
Details below:

[b]- Fixed a small bug that sometimes caused the game to crash
- Fixed an issue with the CG Gallery where some CGs wouldn't show up
- A small number of typos have been fixed[/b]

 [img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33104764/8167c8c1128902bc3e5660bc363c9f9a233e92cb.png[/img]

notes.title: Patchnotes 1.1
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 
We hope you're having a great time playing the game!
Today we have a patch for you guys that addresses some existing bugs and engine issues! 
Details below:

[b]- A number of typos have been fixed[/b]
[b]- Fixed an issue that caused an error when trying to load a save that was created right after using the jump back feature[/b]
[b]- Memory management has been improved[/b]
[b]- The version number displayed in the about window (F1 Key) should now be displayed correctly[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33104764/28a7856278c2e2505f184708bef257d08f472eaf.png[/img]

You can also follow us on our social media to get faster information on our next upcoming games!
